notes: The manuscript says the action on the one-dimensional local moduli factor is trivial when gα0=1 and factors through the symmetric group on Îα0, isomorphic to S4, when gα0=0. It tentatively claims that any subgroup of S4 can occur, with the author’s qualification sauf erreur. No independent verification of that realization claim was performed.

It treats ambient modular dimension 1 as the isolated-vertex case, then ambient modular dimension 2 and modular codimension 1 as the one-edge case. The three illustrated possibilities are a two-vertex genus-zero tree with marked weights 3 and 2 (type (0,5)); a genus-zero one-loop graph with marked weight 2 (type (1,2)); and a two-vertex tree with a genus-one distinguished vertex and a genus-zero vertex of marked weight 2 (type (1,2)). These are descriptions of the manuscript’s cases, not a separately established exhaustive classification.

The three right-hand curves were read stroke by stroke: first, two crossing open branches with two marks a,b on one and three c,d,e on the other; second, a curve with one lower loop and a crossing at its neck, marked a,b below; third, two branches with a filled crossing, a genus-one label on the left and a,b on the right. No crossing dot was added to the first or second curve. In the small introductory segment the left endpoint is an open ring and the right one is filled; that distinction is preserved.

Both live displays carry (72); the author’s repeated numbering is retained. The cancelled leading label also appears more like (72) than (71), but remains uncertain. The completed blind audit finds no independent mathematical sign after d’ordre: the terminal chevron belongs to the cancellation stroke, and the deleted text ends with d’ordre. The first-stage < / 2 / ≤ candidates are superseded and survive only in the frozen first-stage records.

The interlinear clause i.e. où la codim modulaire … de G est 0, sits between the sentence’s main baselines, with s1 inserted again above it. On trouve les trois cas de dim modulaire replaces the cancelled two-line start Dans le cas …; the cancelled 1 belongs to sauf 1, not to the replacement. The live continuation is ambiante 2, dim modulaire 1.

The bottom note says that an unlabelled genus or marked weight is zero and that marked weights are written above the graph vertices. Both ou poids marqué insertions attach after genre, as their curved connectors show. The zero is live; the connector above and beside it is not a cancellation. The first diagram’s 3 is physically below-left rather than directly above its point; that visible placement is retained despite the note’s general description.

Line count 33 is an explicit reading-row count: 20 main baselines including the arrow display, the two cancelled prose baselines and four bottom-note baselines; five interlinear baselines including s1; two rotated marginal-note baselines; two foliation baselines; one separate second (72) label; and each of the three paired drawing rows counted once, with all of its label clusters read individually. This prevents the graphical labels from disappearing from the audit count.

There are 15 single crops, all viewed; the margin crop alone is rotated clockwise by 90 degrees. All doubtful cancelled spans in C were checked even though only M1031 appears in MARKS.tsv. The footer pencil 57 is of uncertain hand. H’s page label, drawing synopses and editorial notes are not manuscript text and were not transcribed as such.

No OCR, internet lookup, TeX compilation or other manuscript page was consulted by the assigned reader. The main reader reviewed every disputed crop and approved the first-pass fragment; the blind audit is now complete. The terminal <|2 candidate is removed: the crop shows an arrow-shaped end of the cancellation, not a separate mathematical sign. The tiny interlinear s1/delta1 and the cancelled weight1/4 remain doubtful.

Current substantive comparison counts after the final classification review: 26 rows, 5 against C and 23 against H; a row may differ from both witnesses. Rows 058-01 (against_C=false) retain only their independently supported witness differences. Complete earlier records and excluded comparisons are preserved separately in workflow/substantive_count_reclassification.json. Earlier first-stage or audit totals describe their historical classification; these are the current counts. No page reading, doubt or adjudication was changed by this counting review.
